anti_overlap: Does NOT cover Go package design (fd-go-package-*) or analysis mode (fd-analysis-*)
decision_lens: Prompt sections must be deterministically composable — the same inputs always produce the same system prompt, and each section's token budget is predictable
focus: Evaluates the persona TOML config model and dynamic prompt injection architecture in Skaffen
name: fd-persona-prompt-architecture
persona: Prompt engineering architect who has designed multi-tenant LLM systems with per-user personality customization
review_areas: Persona TOML schema completeness: does it capture all 8+ dynamic sections from Auraken's prompts.py?
Template variable injection ordering: does {{.LensContext}} before {{.ProfileContext}} create information leakage?
Token budget management: how do dynamic sections (lens context, profile, style) stay within context window limits?
Pre-turn hook latency: will synchronous Haiku calls for lens selection block the conversation loop?
Context provider interface design: can new providers (e.g., memory, calendar) be added without modifying the persona config schema?
Register matching fidelity: Auraken's style-matched mirroring is critical to user experience — how is it preserved?

severity_examples.condition: Agent loses track of conversation mid-exchange
severity_examples.scenario: Dynamic prompt sections exceed context window, silently truncating conversation history

severity_examples.condition: Agent reverts to generic assistant behavior
severity_examples.scenario: Persona TOML cannot express Auraken's anti-pattern rules (no flattery, no AI-isms), losing personality guard rails

severity_examples.condition: Unnecessary latency and cost on routine exchanges
severity_examples.scenario: Pre-turn hook calls Haiku for lens selection on every turn regardless of whether lenses changed

success_hints: Persona TOML validated against Auraken's prompts.py section-by-section; token budget per section with overflow strategy; async pre-turn hooks with caching
task_context: Auraken's OODARC prompt builder assembles system prompts from 8+ dynamic sections. Migration target: Skaffen persona TOML config with template variables ({{.LensContext}}, etc.) populated by context provider hooks. Skaffen already has OODARC phase FSM.
